WEBSITE INFORMATION

Privacy & enquiries

A clear explanation of how this catalogue and its enquiry form work.

Using this website

This website is a product catalogue. It does not accept payments, take orders or create customer accounts.

The enquiry form

The form prepares a message in your browser. It does not submit your details to a website database. Selecting email or WhatsApp opens the chosen service with your message. You review and send the message there.

Your email or WhatsApp provider processes information under its own terms and privacy policy. When you send an enquiry to Shiva Exim, we receive the information you choose to include so we can discuss your request.

Information to include

Please share business contact details and product requirements. Do not include passwords, banking credentials or identity documents in this form.

Cookies and analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand page visits and clicks on email, WhatsApp and enquiry links. Analytics may use cookies and process technical information such as browser, device and approximate location. Our custom events record the action and its placement on the page; they do not send your name, email, phone number, company or enquiry message. Opening a draft is not evidence that an enquiry was sent. Advertising personalization and Google signals are disabled. Our analytics tag is not loaded when your browser sends Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. Hosting and access services may also process technical information needed to deliver the website.

Contact

For questions about an enquiry or a request concerning details you sent, email info@shivaexim.com.
